preconditions.description: The number of even steps is between 0 and 100.
The number of odd steps is between 0 and 100.
The interval starts at least at the first step and ends at most at the last step.

invariants.expression: all(l <= r for l, r in intervals)
invariants.description: The intervals are valid and within the range of step numbers.

invariants.expression: all(even_count(l, r) == a and odd_count(l, r) == b for l, r in intervals)
invariants.description: The intervals contain the correct number of even and odd steps.
